text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Neural Correlates of Internal-Model Loading

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: During

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: skilled object manipulation, the brain relies on internal

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: models of object dynamics to predict motion in response

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to applied force. These internal models are thought to be

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: stored and rapidly recruited for various objects, allowing

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: for efficient handling of a wide range of items. Neural

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: activity linked to grasping an object with recently

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: learned dynamics is associated with activity in specific

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: brain regions, including the ipsilateral cerebellum and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the contralateral and supplementary motor areas. These

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: regions are involved in the preparation for movement

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: execution, particularly in the recruitment of internal

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: models. The cerebellum, in particular, plays a key role in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: motor coordination and learning, while the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: supplementary motor areas are involved in planning and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: executing complex movements. The recruitment of these

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: regions enables the brain to rapidly adapt to novel

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: object dynamics and execute precise movements.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Sensorimotor Network

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The sensorimotor

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: network includes precentral gyrus, supplementary motor area

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and post-central gyrus. It is commonly associated with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: voluntary movement, body motion, and the planning of action

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: sequences. Its hubs are often described as supporting

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: coordinated control over bodily actions.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Supplementary Motor Area

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The supplementary

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: motor area is a large, bilateral cortical region located in the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontal lobe. It is commonly associated with voluntary

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: movement and coordination of body parts during action

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: sequences. In fMRI maps, it often serves as focal regions for

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: complex motor planning. Its anatomy supports both imitation

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: behavior and planned execution.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Motor Execution

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Motor execution commonly

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: occurs in the primary motor cortex, premotor regions

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: including supplementary motor area and cerebellar

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: hemisphere. It supports movement generation from sensory

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: feedback, coordination with other brain networks, timing of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: actions, balance control, voluntary muscle activation, and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: self-regulation during action sequences.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: true map

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Paper text (title + summary)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Amygdala reactivity to faces at varying

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: intensities of threat in generalized

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: social phobia: an event-related

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: functional MRI study.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: In individuals with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: generalized social phobia, the amygdala

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: exhibits heightened reactivity to faces that

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: convey social threat. This increased reactivity

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: is observed in response to faces with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: moderate and high levels of threat intensity.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: In contrast, the amygdala's response to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: subtle displays of social threat is sufficient to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: evoke a fear-related neural response in these

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: individuals. The amygdala, a key region

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: involved in processing emotional stimuli, is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: particularly responsive to faces in individuals

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: with generalized social phobia. This

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: heightened reactivity is thought to contribute

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to the exaggerated fear responses

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: characteristic of social anxiety disorders.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Arousal Network

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: This network is commonly associated

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: with cortical processing of arousal, salience and bodily state. It involves

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the insula, posterior thalamus, anterior cingulate cortex, hippocampus,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: amygdala, periaux cortices, and association areas. Its anatomy supports

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: representation of internal physiological states as well as external

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: environmental signals related to motivation and care.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The network also includes regions that support integration between

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: sensory input from body systems and brain activity in general.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Hypothalamus

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The hypothalamus is a large region of the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: brain involved in homeostasis, thermoregulation, circadian rhythm and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: hormone secretion. It is often associated with integration between bodily

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: signals and environmental demands. Its function includes coordinating

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: physiological responses to maintain body state.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Taste Perception

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Taste perception is the encoding of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: flavor, temperature and texture information from oral contact. It involves

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontal operant cortex with insular regions related to gustation; pituitary

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: gland control over taste processing; amygdala regulation of salience in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: taste experience; brainstem integration of sensory input into a cognitive

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: representation. This concept supports evaluation of food quality,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: preference for flavors or textures, and emotional significance of tastes.
